name: @graph-motor/studio
description: The graph-motor studio as a custom element, <graph-studio>: one action registry behind a floating dock, a console, a HUD and an inspector. The motor runs in a Web Worker. Ships no build: a host bundles src/element.ts.
//toolchain: No node_modules of its own: it type-checks, lints, tests and builds with the toolchain installed in app/ (scripts/studio.sh check).
